text_block_list.text:
I managed to get the Paka Petit! As I 
turned around to hand it to Mejiro Ramonu—

text_block_list.name: Young Girl Fan
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Ramonu-san, please have this 
Paka-Puchi...!

In the brief moments she spent playing the 
game, Mejiro Ramonu had become surrounded 
by fans.

Even more fans arrive to present Mejiro 
Ramonu with Paka Puchi. It's far too many 
to hold.
choice_data_list: I-I'll go get a bag right away!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Excuse me. What about this doll?
choice_data_list: I won this earlier... do you want it?
I won this earlier... do you want it?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"I couldn't very well refuse only yours, 
now could I?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Would you mind displaying it in the 
trainer's room alongside the others later?
